title: Current conversational & online slang (non-rude)
description: Practical vocabulary for current conversational & online slang (non-rude).

cards.english: Incredible; that's wild (positive or negative by tone)
Wow; goodness; well, look at that
Addictive; totally caught up in something
Off-putting; suddenly lose interest; gives the ick
Make someone want to buy or try something
Finally buy something recommended, or lose interest in it
Avoid a bad product or experience; a warning
Have a bad experience; pick a dud
Slack off at work; take an unofficial break
Opt out of constant competition; lie flat
Feel emotionally overwhelmed; one's defenses break
Watch drama or gossip as a spectator
Activity buddy; friend for a particular pursuit
Join together for meals or activities (informal)
Stand someone up; fail to show up
Got stood up; someone canceled on me
Have something go wrong; fail publicly
Have something completely under control; nail it
Captivate someone; hold their attention (online slang)
Socially anxious; shy around people (casual shorthand)
Emotional support or affirmation someone provides
Working stiff; ordinary wage worker (playful self-label)
So shippable; such good chemistry (fandom slang)
I'm shipping them; that chemistry got me (fandom slang)
Direct; straightforward, especially flirting or communication
Funny; full of clever references or jokes
Do a bit; pull a stunt to entertain
I'm laughing so hard I can't cope
I'm numb; I'm utterly done with this
Turns out I love it after saying I wouldn't
Check in; visit a spot and post about it
On-screen scrolling live comments on videos
Watch as a bystander; gather to watch
Know how to; will; be likely to
By all means; absolutely (in warnings); ten million
to participate; to take part; to join
Again; also, often for a repeated event
to offer; to supply; to provide
direct (opposite: indirect 间接); immediate; straightforward
unexpectedly; to one's surprise; in spite of everything
at last; in the end; finally
frequently; constantly; regularly; often; day-to-day; everyday; daily
to speak; to say; to talk
Department; part; classifier for films or machines

grammar.pinyin: Jīn tiān yòu yào jiā bān, zhēn wú yǔ.
grammar.english: Overtime again today. I cannot even.

grammar.pinyin: Tā hěn huì tí gōng qíng xù jià zhí.
grammar.english: She is good at offering emotional support and validation.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge jì huà jīn tiān fān chē le.
grammar.english: This plan went wrong today.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè jiā kā fēi guǎn hěn yǒu sōng chí gǎn.
grammar.english: This café has a laid-back vibe.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ bù cān jiā tǎo lùn, zhǐ xiǎng chī guā.
grammar.english: I am not joining the discussion; I just want to watch the drama.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng yǒu tuán gòu, hěn huá suàn.
grammar.english: This restaurant has a group-buy deal; it is good value.

grammar.pinyin: Jīn tiān wǒ bèi gē le, zhǐ hǎo zì jǐ qù.
grammar.english: I got stood up today, so I had to go alone.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men jīn tiān diǎn cài cǎi léi le.
grammar.english: We made a bad choice when ordering today.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men zhōu mò dā huǒ zuò fàn.
grammar.english: We are teaming up to cook over the weekend.

grammar.pinyin: Tā yòu fàng gē zi le, wǒ děng le hěn jiǔ.
grammar.english: He stood me up again. I waited a long time.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge háng yè yuè lái yuè nèi juǎn le.
grammar.english: This industry is becoming more and more of a rat race.

grammar.markup: {好家伙}，{他}{竟然}{一天}{爬}{了}{这么多}{线}！
grammar.pinyin: Hǎo jiā huo, tā jìng rán yì tiān pá le zhè me duō xiàn!
grammar.english: Wow, he climbed so many routes in one day!

grammar.pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng de cài zhēn jué le!
grammar.english: The food at this restaurant is amazing!

grammar.pinyin: Zhè tiáo xiàn lù tā yǐ jīng ná niē le.
grammar.english: He has already mastered this climbing route.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men zhōu mò qù xīn diàn dǎ kǎ.
grammar.english: Let us check out that new shop this weekend.

grammar.pinyin: Nǐ qiān wàn bù yào jù tòu!
grammar.english: Please do not spoil the plot!

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men kě yǐ yī qǐ pīn dān, gèng pián yi.
grammar.english: We can combine our orders; it will be cheaper.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng ān lì nǐ zhè jiā diàn.
grammar.english: I want to enthusiastically recommend this shop to you.

grammar.pinyin: Tā zài péng you zhōng shì ge xiǎn yǎn bāo.
grammar.english: He is the goofy one who always attracts attention among his friends.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge jià gé zhēn lí pǔ.
grammar.english: This price is ridiculous.

grammar.pinyin: Tā shì shè niú, gēn shéi dōu néng liáo tiān.
grammar.english: He is extremely outgoing and can chat with anyone.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè bù diàn yǐng bǎ wǒ yìng kòng le liǎng xiǎo shí.
grammar.english: This movie completely captivated me for two hours.

grammar.markup: {我们}{打工人}{周末}{终于}{可以}{休息}{了}。
grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men dǎ gōng rén zhōu mò zhōng yú kě yǐ xiū xi le.
grammar.english: We wage workers can finally rest over the weekend.

grammar.markup: {看}{到}{这个}{消息}，{我}{直接}{破防}{了}。
grammar.pinyin: Kàn dào zhè ge xiāo xi, wǒ zhí jiē pò fáng le.
grammar.english: That news got to me emotionally.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu diǎn shè kǒng, bù tài xǐ huan rén duō de dì fang.
grammar.english: I am a bit socially anxious and dislike crowded places.

grammar.pinyin: Xià zhōu yǒu shí jiān ma? yī qǐ yuē fàn ba.
grammar.english: Got time next week? Let us arrange a meal.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge rén zhēn hǎo kē.
grammar.english: These two have such shippable chemistry.

grammar.pinyin: Jīn tiān kāi huì kāi le yì tiān, rén má le.
grammar.english: Meetings all day today. I am completely done.

grammar.markup: {我们}{经常}{一起}{吃饭}，{是}{饭搭子}。
grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men jīng cháng yī qǐ chī fàn, shì fàn dā zi.
grammar.english: We eat together often; we are food buddies.

grammar.pinyin: Suī rán hěn nán, dàn shì wǒ bù xiǎng bǎi làn.
grammar.english: Although it is hard, I do not want to give up.

grammar.pinyin: Tā men zhōu mò yòu zài zhěng huó.
grammar.english: They are doing another goofy stunt this weekend.

grammar.pinyin: Kàn le zhè ge shì pín, wǒ kē dào le.
grammar.english: After watching this video, I am shipping them.

grammar.pinyin: Jīn tiān wǒ yǒu diǎn méi gěng.
grammar.english: I am a bit out of jokes today.

grammar.pinyin: Tā zhè yàng shuō huà zhēn xià tóu.
grammar.english: The way he talks is such a turn-off.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge péng you hěn yǒu gěng.
grammar.english: This friend is really witty.

grammar.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu zài wéi guān zhè jiàn shì.
grammar.english: Everyone is watching this unfold.

grammar.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ zhǐ xiǎng tǎng píng.
grammar.english: I just want to lie flat and take it easy this weekend.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo ge pān yán dā zi.
grammar.english: I want to find a climbing buddy.

grammar.pinyin: Tā shuō huà hěn zhí qiú.
grammar.english: He speaks in a very direct, straightforward way.

grammar.pinyin: Péng you gěi wǒ zhòng cǎo le yī jiā cān tīng.
grammar.english: A friend made me want to try a particular restaurant.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge shì pín de dàn mù hěn yǒu yì si.
grammar.english: The live scrolling comments on this video are funny.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ jiào cuò le míng zi, zhēn shè sǐ.
grammar.english: I said the wrong name. So embarrassing!

grammar.pinyin: Tā zài bàn gōng shì tōu tōu mō yú.
grammar.english: He is secretly slacking off at the office.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge yóu xì tài shàng tóu le.
grammar.english: This game is so addictive.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn bù tài hǎo, dà jiā zhù yì bì léi.
grammar.english: This shop is not great; everyone should avoid it.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ shì chī huò, xǐ huan cháng chang xīn de cài.
grammar.english: I am a foodie and like trying new dishes.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ qián bù xǐ huan zhè ge cài, xiàn zài zhēn xiāng.
grammar.english: I used to dislike this dish, but I have changed my mind and love it.

grammar.pinyin: Tā de gù shi tài hǎo xiào le, xiào sǐ!
grammar.english: His story is so funny. I am dying laughing!

grammar.pinyin: Zhōu mò chū lái wán, xiān qù qù bān wèi.
grammar.english: Going out this weekend should shake off the office-worker vibe.

grammar.pinyin: Kàn dào zhè ge shì pín, wǒ xiào bù huó le.
grammar.english: That video is killing me with laughter.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ zhōng yú qù bá cǎo nà jiā cān tīng le.
grammar.english: I finally tried that restaurant I had been eyeing.
